title: Reliable Evaluation of AI Agents for Investment Research: A Framework for Performance and Validity Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2611.22338v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider the problem of evaluating AI agents undertaking investment-research tasks, where agents interact with external information sources and computational tools to produce financial analyses and research reports. An important challenge is that the quality of an agent's final output does not necessarily reflect the quality of its execution process, while the reliability of the resulting assessment also depends on the validity of the evaluation procedure. Furthermore, investment-research tasks differ considerably in their requirements for numerical accuracy, information retrieval, financial analysis and supporting evidence, making it difficult to assess agent performance using a uniform set of criteria. translated_title: 投资研究领域AI智能体的可靠评估：性能与有效性评估框架
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何评估承担投资研究任务的AI智能体，这些智能体与外部信息源和计算工具交互，以生成金融分析报告和研究报告。一个重要的挑战在于，智能体最终输出的质量并不一定能反映其执行过程的质量，而评估结果的可靠性也取决于评估程序本身的有效性。此外，不同的投资研究任务在数值精度、信息检索、金融分析和支持证据等方面的要求差异很大，这使得难以用一套统一的标准来评估智能体的性能。我们提出了一个面向领域的评估框架，该框架将结果质量与执行质量区分开来，并通过任务特定的评估标准、确定性验证器以及独立的大语言模型（评估器）来适应这些差异。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个面向投资研究领域的AI智能体评估框架，通过区分结果质量与执行质量，并采用任务特定标准、确定性验证器和独立大语言模型评估器，实现对智能体性能与评估有效性的可靠评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a domain-oriented evaluation framework for AI agents performing investment-research tasks, which distinguishes outcome quality from execution quality and employs task-specific criteria, deterministic validators, and independent LLM judges to enable reliable assessment of both agent performance and evaluation validity.
